judgments.reason: While the span 'depigmented spots appeared on the torso' does occur literally in the vignette, it does not clinically support Neurocutaneous Melanosis. Neurocutaneous Melanosis involves excess melanocytic proliferation (hyperpigmented lesions, melanin deposits), whereas depigmented spots are hypopigmented lesions characteristic of Tuberous Sclerosis Complex (ash-leaf macules). The histopathology, TSC1 mutation, tubers, cardiac rhabdomyoma, and polydactyly all point to TSC, not Neurocutaneous Melanosis. The modifier therefore does not reasonably support the completed diagnosis label.
